title: Checking isomorphisms on constructible complexes
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be admissible, let
$F_1,F_2:\Loc(\Dctf(X,\Lambda))\to\Loc(\Dctf(Y,\Lambda))$ be exact functors
preserving direct sums, and let $\eta:F_1\to F_2$ be a natural transformation
of exact functors. If $\eta_K$ is an isomorphism for every
$K\in\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$, then it is an isomorphism for every
$K\in\Loc(\Dctf(X,\Lambda))$.

proof.text:
The objects $K$ for which $\eta_K$ is an isomorphism are closed under shifts
and cones by the five lemma, and under direct sums because $F_1$ and $F_2$
preserve them. They contain $\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$, so by the definition of the
localizing closure [sk-def-localizing-closure] they contain all of
$\Loc(\Dctf(X,\Lambda))$.
